papers_read.title_as_printed: Features of the superficial white matter as biomarkers for the detection of Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment: A diffusion tensor imaging study (Bigham, Zamanpour, Zare; Heliyon 8 (2022) e08725)
Explainable early detection of Alzheimer's disease using ROIs and an ensemble of 138 3D vision transformers (Saad Saoud & AlMarzouqi, Scientific Reports (2024) 14:27756)

what_each_reports.P-152: ADNI2 DTI, 72 subjects (24 HC/24 MCI/24 AD), superficial white-matter features, FCBF selection, SVM, internal 5-fold CV. AD vs HC accuracy 95.8%, AUC 0.99; MCI vs HC accuracy 83.3%, AUC 0.88; AD vs MCI accuracy 83.3%, AUC 0.93. No intervals.
what_each_reports.P-301: ADNI baseline T1 MRI (MALPEM-ADNI), 532 scans (168 CN, 247 MCI, 117 AD); 138 per-ROI 3D vision transformers with a deep-belief-network ensemble, 80/20 train/validation split (results on the validation set). AD vs CN accuracy 0.90, AUROC 0.91; CN vs MCI 0.84, AUROC 0.81; AD vs MCI 0.74, AUROC 0.60; pMCI vs sMCI 0.94, AUROC 0.95; three-class 0.60. No intervals.

quantity_a: P-152's recorded figure: accuracy for AD vs healthy controls (n=48), diffusion-MRI superficial white-matter features, internal 5-fold CV
quantity_b: P-301's recorded figure: accuracy for AD vs MCI (n=364), T1 structural MRI per-ROI 3D ViT ensemble, single 80/20 split
incompatible_if_same: No. On matched contrasts both papers report figures in the same direction: AD vs CN 95.8% vs 0.90, and AD vs MCI 83.3% vs 0.74. Neither gives an interval, and each uses a different modality and model, so neither claims an ordering that the other refutes.

gates.task: mismatch: the recorded P-152 figure is AD vs HC; the recorded P-301 figure is AD vs MCI
gates.validation_tier: match: both internal only (V2): 5-fold CV vs single 80/20 split
gates.modality_family: mismatch: P-152 diffusion MRI (DTI/QSDR, tractography, connectivity networks); P-301 T1 structural MRI

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: accuracy in both, but on different class contrasts (AD/HC vs AD/MCI), different modalities and class balances (24/24 vs 117/247)
performance_validity: flag applies to P-152's recorded figure: AD vs HC AUC 0.99 on 48 subjects with internal CV and no external cohort meets the near-ceiling small-sample exclusion; P-301's figures are below 0.97.
independence: Distinct author groups; both ADNI, participants may overlap
grounds: The record sets P-152's AD vs HC accuracy (95.8%) against P-301's AD vs MCI accuracy (0.74), which are different class contrasts.
The input modalities differ: diffusion-MRI white-matter connectivity features vs T1 structural-MRI regional volumes.
Comparing like with like, the papers do not contradict each other: both find AD vs CN easier than AD vs MCI, and neither reports intervals that would exclude the other.
P-152's AD vs HC figure meets the performance-validity exclusion (AUC 0.99, n=48, internal CV only).
